name: 轮末项目汇报
author: NethielChou
description: 每轮回复结束后自动出现一张汇报卡：指标表格、模型与 token 用量、改动文件、本轮完成的待办，以及可按「已完成 / 进行中 / 待办」折叠的任务状态条。全部由宿主从会话日志推导，不调用模型、不消耗 token。
descriptionEn: A report card under every completed turn: metrics, model and token spend, files touched, what this turn finished, and a collapsible task status bar grouped by done / in progress / left. Derived from the session log on the host; no model calls, no token cost.
